headline: Spotify is now showing an "AI Persona" label on AI-generated artists, including an AI rapper the Bureau of Investigative Journalism investigated.
score_reason: Pool score 6 lowered by 1: the policy was announced on 11 Aug 2026; today's news is the rollout.
importance_line: Spotify listeners can now tell when an artist is invented, but the label does not show whether the music itself was made with AI, and a human artist quoted says the step does not go far enough.
summary: The Bureau of Investigative Journalism reports that Spotify has started rolling out its “AI Persona” badge, announced on 11 Aug 2026, on synthetic artists, including Danny Bones, an AI-generated rapper with over 1 million streams whose creators the Bureau found had made campaign material for the far-right party Advance UK. Music from AI personas is also kept out of Spotify’s editorial and personalised recommendations unless a listener already follows the artist.
notes: The Bureau says Spotify announced the policy six days after it asked about disclosure; Spotify said listeners had complained. Quoted artist J.Chambers is a Manchester dub poet and reggae and hip-hop artist (Bureau).
